runs.title: Bounded adoption and product verification audit
runs.summary: Direct-source audit of killmyidea, Jev Showcase, the TypeSafe playground router, jev-usecases, and the Awesome Jev lead index. killmyidea is a direct-source application with public-deployment metadata but unverified public access and adoption; the other leads remain an unofficial integration, an explicitly mocked demo, an MIT reference harness, or an index. No verified production product was found.
